title: THE TRIM TOOL THAT PREVENTS EXPENSIVE DAMAGE
description:
Original Video Credit: full_steam_designs on IG

This is a no-damage trim removal tool, a specialized pry tool designed to make home improvement projects easier by removing molding, baseboards, and decorative trim without destroying the surrounding surfaces.

Traditional pry bars concentrate force in small areas, which can leave dents in drywall, damage painted walls, or crack the trim itself. This tool uses a wider contact surface and a more controlled design to distribute pressure, allowing cleaner removal and better chances of reusing the material.

For renovation projects, saving existing trim can reduce waste, lower material costs, and eliminate extra repair work after demolition.

A simple change in tool design can turn a messy removal job into a much cleaner process.
